title: BOM v BOK
text: Proof-of-concept sandbox summary (paraphrased from public information; not authoritative text). The Singapore Court of Appeal examined the doctrine of unconscionability as a basis for setting aside a transaction, and discussed the relationship between unconscionability, undue influence, and duress in Singapore law. BOM v BOK is a leading Singapore authority on the narrow doctrine of unconscionability.
